name: Bad Romance
source:
When the prison walls fall, so do the rules. Trapped with dangerously hot villains, our hero must seduce to survive – and embrace their most scandalous powers.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当监狱的高墙轰然倒塌，一切规则也随之瓦解。与危险又性感迷人的恶徒们困在一处，我们的主角必须施展魅惑方能求生——并彻底拥抱自己最骇人听闻的禁忌力量。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
